subject: 吉林文庙大成殿
author: H2v5o68z
source_note: H2v5o68z于2026-04-30的实拍为现貌依据，完整十一开间十二前柱。1909为主要建筑建成，1920年代重修与近现代修缮分别说明；不是1736初创旧庙主体。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make one heritage atlas plate. IMAGE 1 is ONLY the Longmen thin-black-line STYLE master; following photographs determine this subject's geometry, NOT their scene. Draw fine sparse BLACK contours, deliberately simplified joints, a few selected roof/stone detail lines. Every non-ink pixel inside and outside the object is perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. No filled black shadows, grayscale, hatching, color, paper grain, gradient, glow, checkerboard, frame, caption, watermark or lettering. Plaques remain blank. Remove tourists, modern fences, cables, trees, sky, paving, other buildings and all ground shadows. Full uncut subject, apex and own base intact, centered with at least 8% clear margins. This is a faithful present-object illustration, not a speculative reconstruction.

Jilin CITY Confucian Temple DACHENG HALL, not Changchun or Harbin temples. Copy PHOTO2 identifying geometry, remove trees/modern building and banners. EXACTLY ELEVEN independent architectural facade bays made by TWELVE front verandah columns: FIVE bays to left +one central bay +FIVE to right. Left-to-right12visible columns separate11 enclosed beam panels above actual red wooden doorway/window groups. Do not mistake door leaves for bays, do not collapse to9 or7bays. Complete long DOUBLE-EAVED HIP (wudian) roof with long ridge and foursloped roof sides, no projecting triangular gables. Upper roof considerably narrower than lowerroof, two distinct eave/bracket bands, gently lifted corners. Full own shallow stone terrace with balustrades, center broad stair flight and flank stair areas. Preserve wide low hall proportion, near-straight-on shallowperspective. Full composition landscape1536x1024 width86% with7%clear sidemargins, apex and terrace uncut. Sparse thin contours and selected bracket details; no inscriptions, banners, numbers, painted shadow or background.
